name: Sugar Snap Peas with Sun-Dried Tomato Hummus
instructions: Wash and dry snap peas. Set aside.
Wash, dry, and juice lemon into a blender. (Alternatively, the hummus can be prepared in a food processor.)
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Add to the blender.
Peel and roughly chop garlic. Add to the blender.

Roughly chop sun-dried tomatoes. Add to the blender along with water, tahini, oil, and spices. Blend on high for several minutes until smooth. Add more water to the hummus, one tablespoon at a time, if needed, to reach desired consistency.
To serve, divide hummus and snap peas between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
